label: Magicshine Controls
description: Control supported Magicshine lights from the Karoo app or the in-ride field, with lamp selection, quick beam switching, and battery and temperature telemetry.
releaseNotes:
* Expanded the selector gate to BLE names starting with M2-B0, M2-BO, M1-B0, and M1-BO.
* Improved cold-boot ride auto-connect so the light can reconnect from the ride side without opening the app first.
* Added the split in-ride field with direct light control on the left and app launch on the right.
* Improved shared app and ride state syncing for LOW/HIGH and the remembered last light state.
* Refreshed the launcher branding with the new flashlight icon.
